r.evidence_source: The text reports beta values (standardized regression coefficients) for the association between gratitude and loneliness (e.g., 'c-path: \beta = -.44'), but does not provide Pearson's r correlation coefficients.

Number of studies.evidence_source: The text describes 'Mediation analysis of Model 1', 'Mediation analysis of Model 2', and 'Mediation analysis of Model 3', which appear to be different analytical models applied to a single dataset, rather than distinct studies.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details three mediation analyses (Model 1, Model 2, Model 3) investigating the relationship between trait gratitude and loneliness. Model 1 examines psychological flexibility as a mediator, Model 2 explores engaged living as a mediator, and Model 3 includes both psychological flexibility and engaged living. The direct association between gratitude and loneliness (c-path) was consistently reported as \beta = -.44 across all models.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section text describes the three mediation models and their findings.
